response: The tibial tuberosity is a useful anatomical landmark to locate the PCL footprint and predict the probability of its detachment during cruciate-retaining TKA. This knowledge can help predict and avoid instability, consecutive pain, and dissatisfaction after TKA related to PCL insufficiency. Therefore, the tibial tuberosity can be considered a reliable predictor of the PCL footprint location, aiding in the preservation of the PCL during the surgical procedure.
